create_user: create a new user with id, name, email, profile image URL, role, and optional oauth data
get_user_by_id: retrieve a user by their unique id and return the full user model
get_users: query users with optional filters, pagination, and ordering by name, email, or role
update_user_role: update a user's role by their id, e.g. promote to admin or demote to user
delete_user: delete a user by id, removing their chats and group memberships
